question: Starch, as an indicator in the titrations of iodine with thiosulfate:

options.opb: It must be added at the beginning of the valuation.
options.opc: It must be added immediately before the equivalence point.
options.opd: It is only added in evaluations in a non-aqueous medium.

analysis: Starch is commonly used as an indicator in the titrations of iodine with thiosulfate due to its ability to form a blue complex with iodine. This complex is easily visible and helps in determining the endpoint of the titration.
